member.name: T:Regalis.Infrastructure.Adapters.GraphOtpSender
member.summary:
Microsoft 365 mail OTP channel (Otp:Channel = "Graph"), selected by configuration like the other vendor seams (Invariant 5).
App-only ("client credentials") Graph: the app authenticates as itself with ClientSecretCredential against the .default scope and posts to POST /users/{senderEmail}/sendMail. No user signs in, and no mailbox password is held anywhere — the tenant grants the app Mail.Send and can revoke it centrally.
The credential and the client are built once and reused: ClientSecretCredential caches the access token and refreshes it on expiry, so a new one per email would mean a token request per email.
SMS destinations fall back to the log, matching SmtpOtpSender — no SMS vendor exists yet.

member.name: T:Regalis.Infrastructure.Services.BankService
member.summary:
The bank book (document §13–§14).
Reconciliation state lives on TRN_BankTransaction and nowhere else. Matching a bank line to a payment or an expense writes only to the bank row — TRN_Payment, TRN_Invoice and TRN_Expense are never touched — so cash received keeps exactly one owner and a reconciliation can be undone without disturbing the books.
Matching also only ever points at a record that already exists. Nothing here creates a payment or an expense, which is what stops a statement import from duplicating what the system already knows.
An account's balance is derived from its ledger (opening + credits − debits), the same way inventory stock is derived, so there is no stored balance to drift.

Holds and confirmations run serializable transactions whose conflict query takes UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK key-range locks; the filtered unique index UX_Booking_Workspace_Start is the second line of defence; the retrying execution strategy replays deadlock victims (1205). Design Invariant 4: a paid booking produces booking + payment + invoice + QR token + notification atomically — steps succeed or fail together.

member.name: T:Regalis.Infrastructure.Services.QuotationService
member.summary:
Quotations (document §6–§8). Four rules shape this service.
A quotation is freely editable while Draft and frozen once sent: the customer, company, place-of-supply and tax rates are snapshotted at that moment and the PDF is written to disk, so a later settings change or profile edit never rewrites what the customer was quoted — the same rule TRN_Invoice already lives by.
New prices never overwrite an old offer. opens a fresh draft numbered …-R1 and marks the original Revised, so the document the customer approves is always exactly the document they were sent (document §1).
Money is computed here, never accepted from the client. The whole-quotation discount is split across lines in proportion to their value with the last line absorbing the paisa difference, GST is charged per line and split CGST/SGST inside the home state or as IGST outside it, and the total is rounded to the rupee (document §5.2).
Approval and rejection are the customer's own act, recorded with their identity, the moment and their IP. Everything that happens to a quotation — including sends, notes and downloads — is written to the append-only TRN_QuotationEvent timeline.
